Counsel for Applicant :- Arvind Kumar Tiwari Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2. Counter affidavit filed on behalf of the respondent State is taken on record.

3. In terms of the F.I.R. allegations were levelled against the applicant for commission of offence under Section 376 I.P.C.
4.
Subsequently, the F.S.L. report has been furnished through counter affidavit wherein it is mentioned that the parentage of the baby born was not that of the applicant.
Mahesh Kumar vs The State Of U.P. Thru.

entities.text: Mahesh Kumar vs The State Of U.P. Thru
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant argued that since the F.S.L. report does not matched with the applicant, as such the applicant being aged about 52 years languishing in custody since 29.2.2024 having no criminal history, may be enlarged on bail.
6. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail.

7. Considering F.S.L. report contrary to the allegations made by the victim coupled with the fact that the applicant is 52 years of age, languishing in jail since 29.2.2024 having no criminal history, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
8. Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

9. Let the applicant Mahesh Kumar be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No.0051 of 2024, under Sections 376 & 506 I.P.C., Police Station Ikauna, District Shrawasti on his furnishing a personal bond and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions :-
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 15.7.2024 Shukla  Mahesh Kumar vs The State Of U.P. Thru. Its Prin. Secy. ... on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/56477144/
